title: Attachments
empty_hint: No attachments yet. Drag files here, or click + to add a file, link, or note.
drop_hint: Drag files here to attach them
no_note_hint: Drop files here — select a note first
drop_requires_note: Select a note before dropping a file
invalid_link_url: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
preview_ai_hint: Let AI help organize this note
preview_truncated: Large file — showing the beginning only; open it externally for the rest.
preview_no_format: Preview not available for this format.
preview_raw_image: Camera RAW — no preview available; open it in an external app.
preview_note_unavailable: This note is no longer available.
preview_note_empty: This note has no content yet.
preview_reader_truncated: This page is long — showing the first part.
preview_link_unavailable: This page can't be shown in Brise. Open it in your browser instead.
preview_import_to_section_failed: Couldn't import to section — try again.
keep_original_body: This document's text will be extracted and made searchable. Also keep the original file as an attachment?
keep_original_reference_note: Originals over 32MB are not copied — the attachment points at the file where it is. Move or delete it and the preview stops working, and it is not stored in backups.
confirm_delete_body: Will be deleted from disk and cannot be recovered.
slide_converting: Converting slides to PDF… (large decks can take a few minutes)
slide_no_converter: Install LibreOffice to view the slides themselves.
chart_register_hint: A registered chart appears in the attachment bar and gallery and follows the sheet as it changes.
chart_missing_hint: The sheet section or chart this attachment pointed to was deleted. Remove the attachment if you no longer need it.
